Subject: Recap + proposed exec handoff slots

Hi Lena / Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary objective: reduce inference cost on customer-facing features while keeping 95th-pct latency under 300ms for 1-2k QPS bursts.
- Data footprint: mainly short prompts (avg. 90 tokens) with KV cache reuse; sensitive PII in subset of flows (need VPC / KMS).
- Success metric for POC: end-to-end latency SLA & unit cost target under $0.002 per generated token equivalent.

Open qualifiers
- Compliance: do you need SOC 2 evidence or specific retention controls for the pilot?
- Infra: expected steady-state QPS and peak concurrency for first month?

Recommended next steps
1) Executive handoff (VP/CTO): align on org-level constraints and approval path.
2) Technical deep-dive (infra + network): unblock pilot runbook.
3) Mutual action plan and contract milestone check.

Proposed times for a combined exec + technical 45m slot next week (all times in PDT / EDT):
- Tue Jun 16 — 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT
- Wed Jun 17 — 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT (preferred for our CTO)
- Thu Jun 18 — 13:00 PDT / 16:00 EDT

Suggested attendees
- From Finview: Lena Park (Product Lead), Alex Gomez (CTO)
- From Redwood: Hannah (AE), Karthik (Solutions Eng), Marissa (CS lead), Marcus Lin (Infra) — Marcus will join the technical portion.

Agenda (45m)
- 5m: Quick exec intro & goals
- 20m: Technical deep-dive (arch, network, security constraints)
- 10m: Pilot runbook & gating criteria
- 10m: Next steps / approvals / decision owners

Attachments: I attached a draft mutual action plan and a one-pager on our infra approach to speed the prep.

Please confirm the best slot and who on your side will attend; if none of these work, send two alternatives and we will prioritize.

Thanks,
